message.content:
**Uno – Quick Overview** | What | How it works | |------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever you set as the target). Points are earned by winning rounds and are tallied from the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the Uno deck (108 cards).
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Turn order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a reverse card changes direction). On your turn you may play one card or draw from the draw pile. | | **Playing a card** | • You may play a card that matches the discard pile’s **color**, **number**, or **symbol**.
• Wild cards (Wild, Wild Draw Four) can be played on any card.
• After playing, you may optionally change the current color if you played a Wild. | | **Special cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and skips their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and skips their turn (must be challenged if you suspect you could have played a matching card). | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you’re down to one card, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, Draw Two/Reverse/Skip = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Game end** | Play continues until someone reaches the agreed‑upon point total (commonly 500). | **Optional house rules** - *Stacking*: Allow players to stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards instead of drawing. - *No challenge*: Some groups skip the challenge rule for Wild Draw Four. - *Custom scoring*: Use different point totals or add extra points for certain achievements. That’s the core of Uno—simple, fast, and full of surprises!
